status_detail: Conceptual control-logic specification for the RFP's air + Xe dual feed. Every guard is symbolic; every threshold value is TBD until the model or test named in its parameter entry supplies it with a source and an evidence class. Not validated. It asserts nothing about whether a mixed-feed or air-only Hall discharge can be ignited, sustained or throttled: gate 3 is FAIL and the credible transport set is empty. v1.1 (second-lens repair, 2026-09-26): parameterised over the three thrust architectures hall_only, rf_hall and ecr_hall and their pre-ionizer start variants; power guards use P_bus of bus_power_boundary_v1.

rfp_context.reference: DRDO TDF RFP DTDF/06/13516/DSP/ABEP/X/L/M/01 as summarised in CLAUDE.md and abep_sim/constants.py (the RFP text is not in the repository: verify clause references)
rfp_context.requirement_summary: air + Xe propellants; Hall preferred; thrust, power, mass and life limits as in abep_sim.constants:RFPConstraints
rfp_context.note: The state list is a Vyovrinda control-design proposal; the RFP does not enumerate these states (verify).

architecture_context.scope_rule: Hall transport-ensemble uncertainty belongs to the discharge/thrust block only and never enters upstream guard quantities (intake, compressor, gas chambers, valves). Layer-1 calibration-nuisance variables are never guard quantities or parameters (CLAUDE.md next-work item 1).
architecture_context.common_blocks: The RF/ECR arms change only the pre-ionization method; the downstream Hall accelerator, feed state, cathode and bus boundary are common. States, guards and the Xe ledger are therefore shared; the architectures differ only in the pre-ionizer output, its ignition states and its loss/fault handling.

guard_semantics.ALL: every condition in every category holds (entries ANDed); entries starting 'n/a:' impose no condition; t_condition counts how long the full condition set has held
guard_semantics.ANY_PERSISTING: fires when any condition in pressure, discharge_current, flows, power, thermal, inventory, sequence or health holds (ORed) and t_condition, the time that trigger set has held continuously, satisfies the timing entries
guard_semantics.priority: fault > protective > command > degradation > recovery > nominal > retry, evaluated every control cycle
guard_semantics.applies_to: a transition is evaluated only in the configurations it lists; a flag that cannot occur in a configuration (e.g. preionizer_fault for hall_only) is false by construction

expression_grammar.identifiers: declared quantities, parameters or external_refs only

functions.integral: integral(rate, t_in_state): time integral of rate over the dwell in the source state

expression_grammar.numeric_literals: forbidden: every threshold is a named parameter

cathode O-exposure evidence that makes the Xe purge / Xe-fed cathode insufficient or unnecessary
an air-fed cathode demonstrated by test (would add the excluded branch below)
a Xe cost per start/fallback that the mission Xe budget cannot carry

applicability_rule: Each state and transition carries 'applies_to' (configuration ids). The machine of one configuration is the projection onto the states and transitions that list it; every graph property (reachability from OFF, path to a safe state, fault exits) holds per configuration.

power_boundary.definition: all electrical power crossing the spacecraft-side DC boundary for the configuration's architecture: sum of P_load/eta over REQUIRED_COMPONENTS[arch] = hall_discharge, hall_magnet, cathode_keeper, cathode_heater, flow_control, compressor, thermal_control, housekeeping, plus rf_source (rf_hall) or ecr_source + ecr_magnet (ecr_hall)

items.claim: LaB6 emitters degrade in the presence of reactive (oxygen/carbon-bearing) species (motivates XE_PURGE and the Xe-fed cathode)
pointers: Gallagher, 'Poisoning of LaB6 cathodes', J. Appl. Phys. 40(1), 44-51 (1969), doi:10.1063/1.1657092 — recorded by lane_19 as not_accessed (DOI as listed in IEPC-2017-276)

Suzuki, Cho, Watanabe and Kinefuchi, J. Appl. Phys. 135, 103301 (2024), doi:10.1063/5.0188080 — abstract only (Crossref record https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1063/5.0188080, accessed 2026-09-27), qualitative: the abstract reports oxygen and carbon detected on the emitter but attributes the work-function rise and the plume-mode instability mainly to carbon (lanthanum carbide), not to oxygen
items.caveat: lane_19 reports that the accessed sources give no atomic-O or N2 LaB6 threshold (oxygen_poisoning_screen returns NO_QUANTITATIVE_EVIDENCE); the purge need and duration and p_O_cathode_max remain TBD; Suzuki 2024 is therefore not direct evidence of oxygen poisoning

items.claim: attempts to operate a Hall thruster (RAM-HET) on an N2-O2 mixture always required some xenon (~1.5 mg/s) to prevent flame-out; the feed path of that xenon is not stated
pointers: Andreussi et al., 'Development and Experimental Validation of a Hall Effect Thruster RAM-EP Concept', IEPC-2017-377, https://electricrocket.org/IEPC/IEPC_2017_377.pdf (open full text, accessed 2026-09-27), sec. E: 'a certain amount of xenon (~1.5 mg/s) has always been necessary to prevent the flame out'
items.caveat: qualitative only; the text does not say the xenon went to the cathode (the RAM-EP feed supplied Xe to both the cathode and the anode-side auxiliary distributor), so it does NOT support the Xe-fed cathode specifically and is equally consistent with anode-side Xe topping (a mixed feed, cf. MIXED_STABILIZATION / ATMOSPHERE_DOMINANT). The 1.5 mg/s is not used as a parameter value.

items.claim: ignite on Xe, then transfer the anode feed smoothly to N2 or N2/O2 while the cathode continues on Xe (direct support for the start/transfer order and for AIR_ONLY_ANODE_XE_CATHODE)
pointers: Cifali, Misuri, Rossetti, Andrenucci, Valentian, Feili and Lotz, 'Experimental characterization of HET and RIT with atmospheric propellants', IEPC-2011-224, https://electricrocket.org/IEPC/IEPC-2011-224.pdf (open full text, accessed 2026-09-27): 'The PPS1350-TSD was always ignited with xenon. After ignition, a smooth transition from 100% xenon to 100% nitrogen or N2/O2 mixture at the anode was carried out; the cathode continued to work with xenon.'
items.caveat: phase order and feed topology only (a laboratory PPS1350-TSD test at 350 V / 1.4 kW limits); no threshold, flow, ramp rate or duration is taken
